ORCHESTRATOR QC-GATE CORRECTION (2026-08-11): the shard's old_value did not match the live cell, so its merge was computed against the wrong baseline. The live cell holds maps.app.goo.gl/YX3A1GDTjid6P4Jd7; the shard quoted a DIFFERENT short-link (…/E8jUU6cPDUavaCL89) as the existing value and would have replaced the real one with it. The database's own link is live (HTTP 200) and nothing proves it wrong, so it is carried forward and the shard's substitute is not added — a second unverifiable Google Maps short-link adds no evidence for the Location value, which the two named sources carry. Re-check the surviving link's pin before pasting if the coordinate itself is in question (a maps short-link is JS-rendered and cannot be token-verified server-side). old_value replaced with the cell's ACTUAL contents from the fresh export (it previously quoted URLs the database does not hold); the reviewer's 'current value' column now shows what is really there.
